title: small strainer
text: small strainer. This is a great, smaller strainer. Says it's stainless steel and so far, I have no reason to doubt that.  It runs through the dishwasher wonderfully.  It's just the right size to strain small stuff/projects/tea.  The non slip grip handle is really nice.  Overall, this is a really nice stainless strainer.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. product_metadata.title: LiveFresh Fine Mesh Stainless Steel Mini Tea Strainer with Non Slip Handle - 3 inch - Ideal Size for Straining Teas and Cocktails or Sifting Flour, Sugar, Spices, and Herbs
features: 🍓Steep the best cup of tea with ease. Just fill the sieve with your loose-leaf teas and spices and rest it in your drink mug of hot water. Let the very fine stainless steel wire mesh filter the particles from the liquid. Use it at your bar to make cocktails with ease.

🥑Professional quality 3” diameter for lifetime performance. A dependable strainer that will not rust. The perfect small size for straining teas, chai, cocoa, cocktails, lemon juices and sifting spices. The sturdy twilled mesh is tough, pliable, and maintains its form while performing as well as other double-mesh designs.

🍅Durable stainless steel construction with lifetime warranty. The toughest 3 inch stainer available. All welds, and joints are inspected for quality and strength. This strainer will last a lifetime, guaranteed or get your money back!

🍏Dishwasher safe with sealed rim design. Never get food stuck in between the rim and mesh again! Our sealed rim design features a smooth, rounded finish that blocks food particles from getting trapped between the mesh and the rim.

🥬Good Grip, non-slip, heat-resistant handles: soft-touch grips allow you to strain your food easily while maintaining control in slippery conditions and protecting your hands from burns. Excellent kitchen aid for those who struggle with arthritis.
